metadata.name: Slot Week Picker
metadata.description: A booking picker with a swipeable week strip and a grid of time slots. Taken slots stay focusable and explain why; a live starts-in countdown and the time zone with its UTC offset are always shown. The selection uses a liquid blob effect and a particle burst.
metadata.author: vovalopuh13
